prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied painting of a wood desk with phone. Remove ONLY the entire smartphone and its cast shadow, restoring that area with continuous warmly lit wood-grain tabletop matching the surrounding brush texture, lighting and perspective. Keep the exact 1672 by 941 landscape composition, cup upper left, paper and pencil lower left, flower envelope at right, all colors and painted details outside the phone area unchanged. This is a clean background plate for animating a separate phone and hands over it. Absolutely no phone, no hand, no new objects in the center, no writing added. Preserve the high-quality hand-painted anime gouache look and all existing framing.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE production animation CUTOUT on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Use the reference ONLY for the delicate anime feature-film gouache paint finish, warm amber key light from upper left and cool blue rim light from upper right, and black phone design. Subject: a believable young adult's LEFT hand and forearm, pale warm skin, wearing a muted dark-blue cotton sleeve, gently holding a black smartphone UPRIGHT in portrait orientation, screen facing the camera. First-person view from slightly above. Phone is completely vertical in the image with straight parallel long edges, NOT tilted; near-orthographic for animation. Phone's ivory blank screen completely visible, with absolutely no text/UI. The left thumb rests along the LEFT bezel only, not covering the screen. Four fingers curl anatomically behind and barely around the right edge; not across the face of the screen. The wrist and sleeve flow diagonally DOWN LEFT all the way to the bottom edge; the entire phone and hand stay uncropped with generous transparent padding around them, only sleeve can leave bottom edge. Composition: phone occupies horizontal x=40% to 78%, vertical y=12% to 67%; hand wraps around its lower half; cuff around lower-left. Soft painterly outlines, precise graceful anatomy, tactile paper-painted shading, fine but clean enough to animate. ONLY hand, sleeve, and phone. No desk, no cup, no room, no scenery, no shadow ground, no drop shadow, no white backdrop, no grids, no labels. An isolated layered-animation asset, not a full scene.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied TRANSPARENT hand-holding-phone animation asset. Keep the exact canvas dimensions 1024x1536 and smartphone pixel position, shape, blank ivory screen, black bezel, brush detail, lighting and size COMPLETELY UNCHANGED. Remove ONLY the entire human hand, all fingers, wrist and blue sleeve, and remove ALL colored background glows/halos. Replace those removed regions with genuine fully transparent alpha. Reconstruct the very small areas of phone edge previously covered by thumb/fingers, matching the already visible edges. Result: ONLY that same upright black smartphone, on pure transparent background with no colored aura, no ground shadow, no hand or wrist. Do not center it differently or enlarge the phone. Preserve its existing x and y coordinates for precise animation registration.

Use case: illustration-story. Generate a complementary isolated animation cutout of this person's RIGHT hand and forearm, same pale warm skin, muted dark navy-blue knit cuff, same finely painted anime-gouache style and warm amber light from upper left plus a cool blue edge. Genuine transparent background. Show the BACK of the right hand, seen from above, with INDEX FINGER extended diagonally toward upper left as if about to tap a touchscreen; the fingertip is at about x=25%,y=25% of the canvas. Middle, ring and little fingers curl naturally toward palm; thumb relaxed on the left of palm. Wrist goes diagonally down-right and navy sleeve extends out the bottom-right edge. Natural human proportions and graceful anatomy, complete extended index finger entirely in frame with generous padding, no jewelry. This is a single hand animation asset; ONLY hand and sleeve, absolutely NO phone, desk, scenery, colored halo, ground shadow, labels or marks. Fully transparent negative space surrounding the actual hand silhouette, including spaces between fingers. Match the source brush rendering and hand identity without copying the pose.

Use case: precise-object-edit. This supplied transparent animation sprite shows a left hand holding a phone. Remove ONLY the smartphone, replacing the phone area with transparent alpha, and reconstruct the hand surface that the phone was hiding: a natural palm facing up, gently cupped as if about to catch or lift that same phone, thumb and all four fingers anatomically continuous. Preserve exact existing thumb position, existing outer hand silhouette, wrist, navy sleeve, image size 1024x1536, original hand position, original paint style and lighting. Do not move, resize, turn or reframe the hand. The new palm can fill the lower part of the removed phone area, but above the fingertips must be fully transparent. Also remove all orange and blue outer glowing halos outside the actual hand/sleeve silhouette. Result ONLY a natural hand and sleeve on true transparent background, no phone, no object, no aura, no ground shadow or any solid backdrop. This will register under the original phone on a motion animation rig.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Remove ONLY the faint cursive handwritten lettering from the loose cream paper on the lower-left of this desk scene. Restore that same paper with natural blank cream paper texture and identical light/shadows. Keep EVERYTHING else pixel-aligned and unchanged: exact landscape 1672x941 composition, all desk wood grain, completely empty center with no phone, pencil lying on the paper, cup, window, books, pressed-flower envelope on the right, painterly warm-amber and cool-blue lighting. Add nothing. The blank left paper is needed for writing animated lyrics onto it later.
